def transform(grid):
    # Separator lines divide the image into equal square panels; mark panels
    # containing more than one colored object cell.
    sep = 3 if 3 in grid[0] else 9
    rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(x == sep for x in row)]
    cols = [j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if all(grid[i][j] == sep for i in range(len(grid)))]

    cb = [-1] + cols + [len(grid[0])]

            cells=[grid[i][j] for i in range(a+1,b) for j in range(c+1,d)]
            row.append(1 if cells.count(5)>1 else 3)
        out.append(row)
    return out

def transform(grid):
    # Separator lines partition the grid into panels. In each panel, replace
    # the base color by 1 exactly when the other color occurs twice.
    separator_rows=[i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row))==1]
    sep=grid[separator_rows[0]][0]
    rb=[-1]+separator_rows+[len(grid)]
    separator_cols=[j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if all(grid[i][j]==sep for i in range(len(grid)))]
    cb=[-1]+separator_cols+[len(grid[0])]
    result=[]
    for ra,rz in zip(rb,rb[1:]):
        line=[]
        for ca,cz in zip(cb,cb[1:]):
            vals=[grid[i][j] for i in range(ra+1,rz) for j in range(ca+1,cz)]
            base=max(set(vals),key=vals.count)
            other=[v for v in set(vals) if v!=base]
            line.append(1 if len(other)==1 and vals.count(other[0])==2 else base)
        result.append(line)
    return result
